answer: A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, and therefore it burns the zephyr fee twice and still divides one payout. Because the canyon ledger attributes every share, the karst audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 66% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not burn.
